level.why: 兩人短對話，安全規定與可脫帽的地點幾乎照字面出現。

dialogue.t: Rick, please put on your hard hat before you enter the building area.
dialogue.zh: Rick，進入施工區之前請戴上你的安全帽。

dialogue.t: Sorry, I left it in my truck. I'll go get it now.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我把它留在我的卡車上。我現在就去拿。

dialogue.t: Thanks. The new rule says everyone must wear one on the site at all times.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。新規定說所有人在工地都必須隨時戴著。

dialogue.t: Understood. Is it also required in the office trailer?
dialogue.zh: 了解。在辦公室拖車裡也需要戴嗎？

dialogue.t: No, you can take it off there, but put it back on when you come out.
dialogue.zh: 不用，你可以在那裡脫下來，但出來時要再戴上。

dialogue.t: Got it. Where should I leave my lunch bag?
dialogue.zh: 知道了。我的午餐袋該放哪裡？

dialogue.t: Put it in the locker room next to the front fence.
dialogue.zh: 放在前面圍籬旁邊的置物間。

dialogue.t: Okay. I'll be back in two minutes.
dialogue.zh: 好的。我兩分鐘後回來。

q.t: Why does the woman talk to the man?
q.zh: 這位女士為什麼找男子說話？

choices.t: To remind him about a safety rule
choices.why: 她要他進入施工區前戴上安全帽，並說明新規定。

choices.t: To ask him to move his truck
choices.why: 卡車只是他放安全帽的地方。

choices.t: To give him a new job
choices.why: 對話沒有提到新工作。

choices.t: To tell him where to eat lunch
choices.why: 午餐袋是男子之後才問的小事。

q.t: What can be inferred about the man's hard hat?
q.zh: 關於男子的安全帽可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: He does not have it with him.
choices.why: 他說把它留在卡車上，要去拿。
規定要求所有人隨時戴著。

choices.t: He lost it on the site.
choices.why: 他是留在卡車上，不是弄丟。

choices.t: He left it in the office trailer.
choices.zh: 他把它留在辦公室拖車。
choices.why: 辦公室拖車是他之後才問到的地方。

q.t: Where is the man allowed to take off his hard hat?
q.zh: 男子可以在哪裡脫下安全帽？

choices.why: 女士說他可以在那裡脫下來。
置物間是放午餐袋的地方。
對話沒有說可以在卡車旁脫帽。
規定是在工地隨時都要戴。

tag: 查詢工作手套庫存位置

level.why: 兩人短對話，搭配簡單庫存表，只需對照品名與走道即可。

dialogue.t: I need to know where we keep the work gloves, because the new crew starts tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 我需要知道工作手套放在哪裡，因為新的工班明天開始。

dialogue.t: They're in a different aisle from the safety glasses. Why do you ask?
dialogue.zh: 它們和安全眼鏡不在同一條走道。你為什麼問？

dialogue.t: We have forty workers, and each of them needs one pair, so please check we have enough.
dialogue.zh: 我們有四十位工人，每人需要一雙，所以請確認夠不夠。

dialogue.t: Let me look at the sheet. Yes, we have plenty, even after the other crews take theirs.
dialogue.zh: 我看一下表單。有，很充足，就算其他工班領走他們的也夠。

dialogue.t: Good. I'm busy until three, so could you bring them to the loading area then?
dialogue.zh: 很好。我忙到三點，所以你可以到時候把它們送到裝卸區嗎？

dialogue.t: Of course. Do you also need cable ties for the electricians?
dialogue.zh: 當然。你們的電工也需要束線帶嗎？

dialogue.t: Not this time. Just the gloves, please.
dialogue.zh: 這次不用。只要手套就好。

dialogue.t: Okay. I'll bring them to the loading area at three o'clock.
dialogue.zh: 好的。我三點會把它們送到裝卸區。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which aisle will the woman go to?
q.zh: 請看圖表。這位女士會去哪一條走道？

choices.why: 男子要的是工作手套，表上手套在 B 走道，數量 80 足夠 40 位工人使用。
A 走道放安全眼鏡，女士說手套不在同一條走道。
C 走道是束線帶，男子說這次不需要。
D 走道是鋼管，對話中沒有人要鋼管。

q.t: What does the man mean when he says, "I'm busy until three"?
q.zh: 男子說「I'm busy until three」是什麼意思？

choices.t: He cannot collect the gloves before three o'clock.
choices.zh: 他三點前無法去領手套。
choices.why: 所以他請女士三點時把手套送到裝卸區。

choices.t: He no longer needs the gloves.
choices.why: 他最後仍說只要手套。

choices.t: The new crew starts at three.
choices.why: 新工班是明天開始，三點是送貨時間。

choices.t: He will finish all the work at three.
choices.zh: 他三點會完成所有工作。
choices.why: 他只說忙到三點，沒有說工作全部完成。

q.t: What will the woman do at three o'clock?
q.zh: 這位女士三點會做什麼？

choices.t: Bring the gloves to the loading area
choices.why: 她說三點會把手套送到裝卸區。
束線帶她問過，但男子說這次不需要。
對話沒有提到清點眼鏡。
電工只是她詢問束線帶時提到的對象。

level.why: 兩人短對話，問題、指示與替代方案都以直白句子說明。

dialogue.t: Mr. Hall, there's a large puddle near the loading dock, and it looks slippery.
dialogue.zh: Hall 先生，裝卸碼頭附近有一大灘水，看起來很滑。

dialogue.t: Thanks for telling me. Did anyone fall?
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你告訴我。有人跌倒嗎？

dialogue.t: No, but a forklift almost slid yesterday. I think a pipe is leaking above it.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，但昨天有一台堆高機差點打滑。我想是上面的管線漏水。

dialogue.t: I'll call maintenance now. Can you put a warning cone there?
dialogue.zh: 我現在就打給維修部門。你可以在那裡放一個警示錐嗎？

dialogue.t: Sure. We have cones by the main door.
dialogue.zh: 好。我們在大門旁有警示錐。

dialogue.t: Good. Please also tell the drivers to use the north dock until it's fixed.
dialogue.zh: 很好。也請告訴司機們，修好之前先使用北邊的碼頭。

dialogue.t: I'll tell them right away.
dialogue.zh: 我馬上告訴他們。

dialogue.t: Thanks. Maintenance should arrive within an hour.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。維修人員應該一小時內會到。

choices.t: A slippery area on the floor
choices.zh: 地板上有一處很滑的區域
choices.why: 她說裝卸碼頭附近有一大灘水，看起來很滑。
堆高機只是提到差點打滑，並沒有壞掉。
警示錐是男子之後要求她放置的，並非遺失。
維修人員還沒被叫，並沒有遲到。

q.t: What does the man ask the woman to do?
q.zh: 男子要求這位女士做什麼？

choices.t: Place a warning cone near the puddle
choices.why: 他問她能不能在那裡放一個警示錐。
要打電話的是男子自己。
對話中沒有要她修理管線。

choices.t: Drive the forklift to the north dock
choices.zh: 把堆高機開到北邊碼頭
choices.why: 他是要她通知司機改用北邊碼頭，不是要她開堆高機。

q.t: What can be inferred about the north dock?
q.zh: 關於北邊碼頭可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: It is safe to use for now.
choices.why: 修好之前，經理要司機改用北邊碼頭。
如果它也漏水，就不會被指定為替代地點。
經理要司機使用它。

choices.t: It is next to the main door.
choices.why: 大門旁只是放警示錐的地方，沒有提到碼頭位置。
